TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT (ELECTIVE)!
NARRATIVE

The property is located at 2523 W. Augusta Blvd, Chicago, IL 60647. The /ot is 3,117.5 square
feet. The property measures 25 feet along the W. Augusta Blvd. frontage. Currently, the subject
property is improved with a vacant residential building.

The property is owned by 2523 W. Augusta, LLC (the “Applicant”).

The Applicant seeks to rezone the subject property from RS-3, Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House District to RM-4.5, Residential Multi-Unit District to develop a Multi-Unit (3+
Units) Residential building comprised of three (3) Dwelling Units with a three-car garage. The
proposed building height is 45°-0” and the proposed building area is 5,015 SF. Pursuant to
Section 17-2-0207, Multi-Unit (3+ units) Residential is permitted by-right in the RM-4.5 district.

(a) Floor Area Ratio. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0304-A, the maximum FAR in the RM-4.5
district is 1.70. The proposed project’s FAR is 1.60 (ie., 5,015 SF building area + 3,117.5 SF lot
area = 1.60). Therefore, the project conforms to the FAR standards.

(b) Density. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0301-A, the minimum Jot area in the RM-4.5 district
is 1,650 square feet. The subject property’s dot area is 3,117.5 square feet. Therefore, the project
conforms to the minimum /ot area.

Section 17-2-0302 does not contain a minimum Jot frontage for lots in the RM-4.5 district.

Pursuant to Section 17-2-0303-A, the minimum Jot area per unit in the RM-4.5 district is 700
feet per Dwelling Unit. The proposed project will be comprised of three (3) Dwelling Units.
Therefore, the minimum /o¢ area per unit is 2,100 square feet. The subject property’s /ot area is
3,117.5 square feet. Therefore, the project conforms to the minimum /of area per unit standards.

(c) Off-street Parking. Pursuant to Section 17-10-0207-A, the minimum vehicle parking
requirement is 1 space per unit resulting in a minimum parking requirement of three (3) off-street
vehicle parking spaces. The project proposes three (3) off-street spaces. Therefore, the project
conforms to the minimum vehicle parking requirements.

(d) Front Setback. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0305-B, buildings and structures in RT, RM and
DR districts must be set back from the front property line a distance equal to either: the

minimum front setback standard of 15 feet (or 12% of lot depth, whichever is less) or the average
front yard depth that exists on the nearest 2 lots on either side of the subject lot. In RT, RM and
DR districts the decision to comply with the fixed front setback standard or the average front
setback standard is left to the builder / property owner except in the case of lots with lot frontage

on a primary boulevard, as defined in Sec. 17-17-02124, where buildings and structures must be
set back from the front property line a distance equal to the average front yard depth that exists
on the nearest 2 lots on both sides of the subject lot; there is no maximum depth to the required
setback along a primary boulevard as defined in Sec. 17-17-02124. In this case, the requirement
is 9°-0”. The proposed building front setback is 9’-0”. Therefore, the project conforms to the
minimum front setback standard.

Rear Setback. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0306-C, the minimum required rear setback is
30% of lot depth or 50 feet, whichever is less. Regarding this project, the required minimum is
37Al feet. The proposed rear setback is 37.44 feet. Therefore, the project conforms to the
minimum rear setback standard.

Rear Open Yard. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0307, the minimum rear open yard space is
202.63 SF. The proposed project will provide 203 SF rear open yard space. Therefore, the project
conforms to this standard.

Side Setback. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0309-A, combined total width of side setbacks
must equal 20% of lot width with neither required setback less than 2 feet or 8% of lot width,
whichever is greater; no side setback is required to exceed 5 feet in width. Here the side setback
requirement 5°-0” combined. The proposed east side setback is 2’-0” and the proposed west side
setback is 3’-0” for a total of 5’-0”. Therefore, the project conforms to the required side setback
standard.

(e) Building Height. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0311-A, the maximum building height is 47”.

The proposed building height is 45”. Therefore, the project conforms to the building height
standards.
